Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 1a) shows two distinct nodules indicated by arrows: one in the right middle lung zone and another retrocardiac on the left. In the context of DIPNECH (Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia), visible nodules on imaging typically represent carcinoid tumors, which are defined as being larger than 5 mm (whereas tumorlets are <5 mm and usually not visible on plain radiographs).
